title: Cloud Run jobs: work that finishes instead of serving

videos.script: Some work has no request and nobody waiting. It just has to be done, every night, and then stop. That is a Cloud Run job. {{tasks}} First, three words. A job is the definition. An execution is one run of it. A task is one piece of that run. {{index}} Every task runs the same image. The only thing that differs is its index. So the program has to cut the work itself, and you will see the shop's invoices cut three ways. {{retries}} Then failure. A task that fails is tried again, with the same index. So some work may happen twice, and the writes have to be safe to repeat. {{schedule}} Last, the schedule. A job has none of its own. Cloud Scheduler starts it, at two in the morning, in São Paulo's time.
